reason: Replace transfer-era acceptance and proof lanes with destination-copy and source-immutability truth.

acceptance_criteria: Organization owners, recovery, billing, 2FA, policy, destination names, exact five-copy allowlist, two-control denylist, and four-private/one-public visibility matrix are verified
Each approved source has a redacted exact-ref source-before manifest and every non-Git GitHub surface has a truthful recreate, retain-source, omit, or operator-action disposition
Exactly five empty agent-logic destinations are created in order, destination Actions are disabled before any mirrored ref arrives, and every source repository remains unchanged
Each destination has exact Git ref and object parity, complete Git LFS parity or a proven no-LFS disposition, the required visibility, and reconstructed or dispositioned destination configuration
A source-after manifest proves owner, visibility, default branch, refs, HEAD, and settings inventory remain unchanged for every copied source
ADL copies last and remains public; its destination Actions stay disabled until environments, rulesets, secrets/variables names, OIDC, packages, Apps, security, and workflow activation are verified
Website reference cutover is delegated to #5888 and starts only after the public ADL destination passes verification
danielbaustin/asksifu and danielbaustin/Horust remain unchanged and no corresponding agent-logic destination exists
Final evidence contains no secret values, no unsupported metadata-copy claims, no unexplained drift, and one exact-revision bounded review

steps.action: Verify organization readiness and capture the exact seven-repository read-only preflight plus per-surface copy dispositions
Create and verify each destination serially with Actions disabled before mirror push and source-after immutability proof before continuing
Record #5888 handoff, negative controls, final copy report, focused validators, and exact-revision review

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate exact repository order and visibility, source-before/destination-after/source-after manifests, Actions-disabled-before-push receipts, Git/LFS parity, #5888 handoff, controls, and zero unexplained drift.

Inspect the five live destinations and re-read all seven source controls, proving destination visibility/configuration and source immutability without claiming issues or settings were mirrored by Git.
